snacs-adaptation-notes.txt:
SNACS v2.6: annotate each target [scene role, lexical function], both p.-prefixed. Scene role is its contextual relation; function is the marker's conventional meaning. Use the same label when no construal is needed. Do not infer labels from the preposition alone; distinguish the local semantic relation.

Constraints: p.Participant and p.Configuration are abstract inventory nodes, not labels for English targets; p.Content is not expected for English. p.Experiencer, p.Stimulus, p.Originator, p.Recipient, p.SocialRel, p.Org, p.OrgMember, p.Ensemble, and p.QuantityValue serve as scene roles, not lexical functions.

Time and space: 'a few years since I have been,' 'after relocating,' 'after our meal,' 'during the session,' 'on 3 occasions,' and 'at all times' = p.Time/p.Time. Causal 'since the designer is unknown' = p.Explanation/p.Explanation. 'Throughout the year' and 'sleeping through the night' = p.Duration/p.Duration. 'For the first time' = p.Frequency/p.Frequency. 'From the day I moved in' = p.StartTime/p.StartTime. 'Within 3 hours' = p.Time/p.Interval. 'As soon as I could' first as = p.Time/p.Extent and second as = p.ComparisonRef/p.ComparisonRef. Ordinary temporal markers do not receive spatial construal just because a metaphor is possible.

Spatial distinctions: 'relocating to South Bend,' 'deliver to 17th and Locust,' and 'come to my premises' = p.Goal/p.Goal; 'get it back' and 'brought the car back' = p.Direction/p.Direction. 'At the bottom/front/payment area,' 'in town/Saratoga/the car/a salon,' and 'on campus' = p.Locus/p.Locus. 'Slapped pieces of wood over' and 'got home' = p.Goal/p.Locus. 'A couple of blocks up the street' = p.Locus/p.Path, while 'go up' = p.Direction/p.Direction. People at an organization ('people at Fidelity Leasing') = p.Org/p.Locus; a physical school in 'time at Franklin High School' = p.Locus/p.Locus.

Possessives: identify the noun's relation; do not default all possessives to p.Possessor. 'Stuart's strategies,' 'my name,' 'its name,' 'my address,' 'his fault,' and misspelled 'there prices' = p.Gestalt/p.Gestalt. 'Our business' = p.OrgMember/p.Possessor; 'my gym' = p.OrgMember/p.Gestalt. 'Your contributions,' 'their service/work,' and 'our meal' where owner performs/provides event = p.Agent/p.Gestalt. 'My waitress/friend/daughter,' 'our waitress,' and 'a customer of mine' = p.SocialRel/p.Gestalt; 'my own counseling practice' is attested p.SocialRel/p.Gestalt. 'Your money/time,' 'our drinks,' 'my gate,' 'his shoes,' and 'my premises' = p.Possessor/p.Possessor. 'Your support queries' = p.Originator/p.Gestalt; 'your custom printing needs' = p.Experiencer/p.Gestalt; 'my hair' = p.Whole/p.Gestalt.

Participant relations: 'rewards of this program' = p.Force/p.Force (program as causal source). 'Each/four/all/many of you/us/the people/them' and 'some of the best options' = p.QuantityItem/p.Whole. 'A couple of blocks' = p.QuantityItem/p.QuantityItem. 'Proud of your contributions' and 'beware of the nail program' = p.Stimulus/p.Topic. 'Recommend this place to anyone' and 'give the phone to a girl' = p.Recipient/p.Goal. 'Wait for my waitress,' 'bother with this,' 'ask for the dinner combo,' 'look for an establishment,' 'waste time on routes,' and 'look for an affair' = p.Theme/p.Theme. Communication/aboutness: 'argue with that,' 'no excuse for that kind of estimate,' 'calling about one board,' 'review about my practice,' 'chasing them on issues,' and 'issues with funds' = p.Topic/p.Topic. Physical accompaniment can differ: 'talk with someone' = p.Agent/p.Ancillary; 'cramped with Kumon parents' = p.Circumstance/p.Circumstance. Passive 'taken by a gentleman' = p.Agent/p.Agent.

Purpose and comparison: 'establishment for New Year's Eve dinner,' 'need for a lawyer,' 'area to sit,' 'to design invitations,' and 'for whatever else ... needs' = p.Purpose/p.Purpose. 'Routes set for children' and 'eating options for students' = p.Beneficiary/p.Beneficiary. 'Recommend to save your time' is not a labeled target in its example; do not infer an infinitive label from that instance. 'Something like smorgasbord' and 'huge experience for such a small salon' = p.ComparisonRef/p.ComparisonRef. 'Look like they were flooded' = p.Theme/p.ComparisonRef. 'Big enough for a Mini Cooper' = p.ComparisonRef/p.Purpose. 'As a silver Marriott member' = p.Identity/p.Identity.

Of and configuration: 'a variety of many kinds of things,' 'that kind of estimate,' and 'that kind of space' use p.Species/p.Species. 'Pieces of wood' = p.Stuff/p.Stuff; 'sampler of IPA...' = p.Characteristic/p.Stuff. 'The way of doing nails' = p.Gestalt/p.Gestalt. 'Owners of Bowtie' = p.Possession/p.Theme. 'Out of the Chocolate Lava Cake' = p.Possession/p.Possession. 'From showing the cars to doing the paperwork' = p.PartPortion/p.Source and p.PartPortion/p.Goal respectively.

Other attested constructions: 'On time' = p.Manner/p.Locus; 'in a way I could do it' = p.Manner/p.Manner; 'in person' = p.Circumstance/p.Locus; 'over the phone' = p.Instrument/p.Path. 'By far' and 'AT ALL' = p.Extent/p.Extent. 'In the process of' = p.Circumstance/p.Circumstance. 'In what state I am' = p.Characteristic/p.Locus. 'As I am enrolled...' meaning because = p.Explanation/p.Explanation; 'because of his shoes' likewise. 'Without a dress name or style number' = p.Instrument/p.Instrument. 'For only 70p' = p.Cost/p.Cost; 'per unit' = p.SetIteration/p.SetIteration. Distinguish actual comparison, kind/category, material, purpose, and participant relations by context.
